inspections.title: Ensure that residents are fully informed and understand their health status, care and treatments
inspections.detail: Ensure that residents are fully informed and understand their health status, care and treatments.

inspections.title: Pharmacist drug review not done properly
inspections.detail: Ensure a licensed pharmacist perform a monthly drug regimen review, including the medical chart, following irregularity reporting guidelines in developed policies and procedures.

inspections.title: Medicare/Medicaid coverage notice not given
inspections.detail: Give residents notice of Medicaid/Medicare coverage and potential liability for services not covered.

inspections.title: Resident assessment inaccurate
inspections.detail: Ensure each resident receives an accurate assessment.

inspections.title: Initial care plan not done within 48 hours
inspections.detail: Create and put into place a plan for meeting the resident's most immediate needs within 48 hours of being admitted

inspections.title: Care plan incomplete
inspections.detail: Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.

inspections.title: Accident hazards or not enough supervision (falls, wandering)
inspections.detail: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.

inspections.title: Incontinence or catheter care problems
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.

inspections.title: Medication error rate of 5% or more
inspections.detail: Ensure medication error rates are not 5 percent or greater.

inspections.title: Care not given as ordered
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

inspections.title: Provide pharmaceutical services to meet the needs of each resident and employ or obtain the services of a licensed pharmacist
inspections.detail: Provide pharmaceutical services to meet the needs of each resident and employ or obtain the services of a licensed pharmacist.

inspections.title: Breathing / oxygen care problems
inspections.detail: Provide safe and appropriate respiratory care for a resident when needed.

inspections.title: Significant medication error
inspections.detail: Ensure that residents are free from significant medication errors.

inspections.title: Food stored or prepared unsafely
inspections.detail: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

inspections.title: Transfer / bed-hold notice not given
inspections.detail: Provide the required documentation or notification related to the resident's needs, appeal rights, or bed-hold policies.

inspections.title: Care plan not updated on time
inspections.detail: Develop the complete care plan within 7 days of the comprehensive assessment; and prepared, reviewed, and revised by a team of health professionals.

inspections.title: Care not given as ordered
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

inspections.title: Not enough food or fluids
inspections.detail: Provide enough food/fluids to maintain a resident's health.

inspections.title: Help with daily activities not provided
inspections.detail: Provide care and assistance to perform activities of daily living for any resident who is unable.

inspections.title: Psychiatric drugs not reduced or reviewed as required
inspections.detail: Implement gradual dose reductions(GDR) and non-pharmacological interventions, unless contraindicated, prior to initiating or instead of continuing psychotropic medication; and PRN orders for psychotropic medications are only used when the medication is necessary and PRN use is limited.

openings.note: Estimate: certified beds minus average daily residents (CMS). Certified beds are often more than the beds actually staffed. Call to confirm.

bio: For-profit nursing home in North Platte with 94 certified beds, part of Avid Healthcare Group. Provides 24-hour skilled nursing care, long-term care, and short-term rehab. Part of a continuing care retirement community, so residents can move between levels of care on one campus.
